verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 ships an official CLI, `s0`, documented in its own GitHub repo. First-party docs say it can run non-interactively in GitHub Actions for image build/push, template updates and sandbox orchestration, which suits scripted, agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: a detailed CLI command reference or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. structured/JSON output) in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: GitHub Actions can run `s0` non-interactively for common Sandbox0 automation flows such as image build/push, template updates, and sandbox orchestration.
